global-api.why: window.Chat is only assigned inside a useEffect after React mounts, so a macro click before mount throws, and the summary never flags this timing/load-order change.

single-socket.why: The effect creates one socket, StrictMode isn't used, and cleanup sets a per-effect `disposed` flag, clears the timer and closes the socket, so onclose skips reconnecting.

backoff.why: useChatSocket keeps `Math.min(30000, 1000 * Math.pow(2, retry++))` and resets `retry = 0` in onopen.

queue.why: send pushes to queueRef when the socket isn't OPEN, and onopen flushes it with `splice(0).forEach` in order.

render.why:
Messages render as `
  • {m.user + ': ' + m.text}
    • ` appended in order, and a useEffect on messages sets scrollTop to scrollHeight.

no-silent-changes.why: The summary calls out the new close-on-unmount, the window.Chat bridge, the empty-message behaviour and the index keys, and no other unflagged behaviour changes are evident.
